title: The component-site projection for an affine scheme
statement:
Let $T$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], and put $P=\pi_0(|T|)$, the quotient by connected components with its quotient topology [lem-pe-spectral-components-profinite]. Use the universes of [def-weil-size-convention] and the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $P_{\mathrm{proet}}$ be the site of profinite spaces over $P$ with finite jointly surjective covering families. For a profinite map $E\to P$, there is an affine ind-etale $T$-scheme $T_E$, whose underlying locally ringed space is $|T|\times_P E$ with the inverse-image structure sheaf from $T$. Its component space is canonically $E$. The functor $E\mapsto T_E$ preserves finite limits and coverings and defines a geometric morphism
$$\pi_T:\operatorname{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{proet}})\longrightarrow\operatorname{Sh}(P_{\mathrm{proet}}).$$
For every sheaf of sets $F$ on $P_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and every quasi-compact quasi-separated object $W\to T$ of $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$, there is a canonical identification
$$(\pi_T^{-1}F)(W)=F(\pi_0(|W|)\to P),$$
natural in $F$ and $W$. The same formula applies to sheaves of abelian groups and rings, preserving their operations.
